caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a woman's dress from the nineteenth century, illustrated in pencil on a beige or off-white background. The dress features long sleeves, a fitted bodice, and a V-shaped neckline decorated with multiple layers of ruffles or lace trim. The skirt is full and is composed of several horizontal bands or flounces, each edged with decorative trim. There is an elaborately draped overskirt or train gathered to one side, extending downward and outward, and also finished with similar trim along the edges. At the gathering point of the train, there is a bow or rosette with trailing ribbons. The composition is centered on the page, showing only the dress without any mannequin, head, or limbs, and there are handwritten notes at the bottom of the page indicating "Valentine Museum - Richmond Va." and a date or catalog number in pencil. The image has some visible discoloration and aging marks around the edges.
title: Dress
